articles.title: Researchers Uncover GhostShares Flaw That Makes Meta Muse AI Conversations Easy to Find
articles.summary:
A privacy weakness in Meta’s Muse AI assistant that made shared conversations discoverable through passive DNS records, exposing personal files and internal business documents. Dubbed GhostShares, the issue affected public sharing links whose supposedly unguessable identifiers appeared inside searchable hostnames. Meta told Ars Technica on October 20 that it was suspending the feature. The finding […]
